Purpose and exclusions

Authored configuration for World map, minimap, markers and discovery. Runtime state never resides on this instance.

Never bypass the declared rule owner, mutate an authored definition at runtime, trust a client completion claim, or infer a compiled implementation from this page.

Creation and configuration

  1. Select DA_Map_Rillmere in Content Browser; set DefinitionId to a stable domain ID, then set the fields in the linked feature contract.
  2. Assign this instance to the consuming native owner through its Blueprint child/defaults or catalog; a content file that is never assigned has no runtime effect.

Required sequence: create native prerequisites -> actual build -> child/data creation -> configure -> assign to listed consumer -> save -> run named fixture. A compiled shell without its consumer assignment is not feature completion.

Lifecycle and cleanup

  1. Author and validate stable definition/frame/field identity before use; load through declared references at readiness.
  2. Consumers may cache read-only references for their world/session lifetime; do not mutate the shared definition or place player quantities on it.
  3. On reimport/version change validate compatibility and migrate persistent IDs deliberately. Missing required rules fail closed; missing cosmetic layers use documented fallback.
  4. World/pawn teardown releases runtime references; persistent records retain IDs and versions only. Reconnect resolves the same definition without replaying grants.

Concrete player-to-authority flow

Participation in World map, minimap, markers and discovery. Rule owner: URPGDiscoveryComponent. This asset’s role is Authored configuration for World map, minimap, markers and discovery. Runtime state never resides on this instance.

  1. Server verifies the capsule entered a registered discovery volume on a valid surface and emits a stable discovery event.
  2. Backend adds the region/landmark unlock once, returns revision and any deliberately authored reward entitlement.
  3. UI overlays discovered regions, quest-owner markers, party markers and current approved location using the zone map transform.
  4. Interior/bridge layers use explicit floor/layer IDs; do not pretend a flat sprite map automatically describes every 3D height.
  5. Selecting a marker shows route/zone destination and services; only unlocked safe hubs expose fast-travel requests.
  6. On zone handoff switch map catalog after destination readiness; clear old actor markers and retain durable discoveries.

Named fixture and acceptance

Fixture: L_Rillmere / Landmark_OldSluice / Region_WestRoad. Configure this asset at its first phase and run the linked phase recipe. Actual result: not run in Unreal/backend during documentation generation.

Stimulus / expected result
Client requests discovery without being in volume -> reject; no unlock.
Duplicate entry/reconnect -> one discovery record/reward.
Quest marker from old zone arrives late -> ignored by zone generation.
Minimap maps bridge to wrong layer -> content validation/QA failure, not navigation teleport.

Record expected/observed separately. Reopen the concrete map consumer; inspect authoritative state, stable IDs/revisions and UI. Static link checks cannot satisfy this gameplay test.

Common mistakes and staged limits

Do not put mutable stock, current health, inventory quantities or player quest progress on a shared Data Asset. A soft reference still needs validation and readiness.

Do not build later references as empty shells in an earlier phase. Source-derived art rows remain blocked by the missing ZIP; plugin API bindings remain blocked by installed-source verification. Placeholder visuals and proposed tuning are explicitly not production proof.
